INSTALLATION SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< SHIFT LOCK CABLE (SELECTOR LEVER SIDE) 
INSTALLATION
1. Place the selector lever in position "P."
2. Fasten the shift lock cable at the position where the end of 
the shift lock cable is positioned above the red marking.
>>B<< KEY INTERLOCK CABLE (STEERING LOCK 
CYLINDER SIDE) INSTALLATION
Turn the ignition key to the "LOCK" (OFF) position and install 
the key interlock cable.
>>C<< KEY INTERLOCK CABLE (SELECTOR LEVER SIDE) 
INSTALLATION
1. Install the key interlock cable on the lock cam.
2. Install the spring and washer of the key interlock cable as 
shown.
3. While lightly pushing the cable coupling portion of the lock 
cam in the direction A, tighten the locking nut to the 
specified torque.
Tightening torque: 12 ± 2 N⋅ m (102 ± in-lb)
